ui.title_cos: Federal Title & Escrow, District Title, KVS Title, all in Washington DC
ui.law: DC lets you assign a purchase contract; say in the contract that you may assign it and market only your contract, not the house. If a tenant lives in the house, check DC's tenant purchase law (TOPA) with the title company before you sign. Most DC foreclosures are non-judicial but must go through city mediation first.
ui.groups: "DC REIA", "DMV Real Estate Investors", "DC Maryland Virginia Wholesale Deals"
ui.prefc: Vacant and blighted: the city inspects buildings and moves empty ones to tax class 3 and blighted ones to class 4, which are taxed at 5 and 10 times the normal rate. Those owners are losing money every month. Back taxes and tax sale come from the city tax bill for each lot.
ui.buyers_h: Active cash buyers (tax office sale records)
ui.buyers_note: Companies that bought 2 or more houses in the last 18 months, from the city sale data, most active first. Skip the big institutions and builders; the 2 to 20 purchase LLCs are the ones who buy wholesale deals. Look up the owner on DC CorpOnline and call.
ui.buyers_empty: No buyers found in the sale data yet.
ui.repairs: Repairs, Washington DC rough numbers per house: cosmetic 25-40k, kitchen+baths 45-75k, roof 12-25k (flat roofs on rowhouses), HVAC 10-18k, full gut of a rowhouse 150-250k.
ui.sources: DC Office of Tax and Revenue public tax extract (owner, billing address, homestead, tax class, assessed value, last sale, tax balances and tax sale flags)
